about: Hand check of the documented findings at v0.10.0 (46c8fe8), done by reading the pinned source and spec on 14 Nov 2026. confirmed: the code and the spec visibly differ; unconfirmed: depends on live API behaviour. These labels say the mismatch is visible, not that it is a bug: the server also validates, so a missing client bound means a late 422. Findings sharing one cause are grouped under root_causes.

findings.label: confirmed
findings.evidence: the tool input is z.string().optional() with no max (src/tools.ts); the spec documents systemPrompt maxLength 20000

root_causes.title: offset has no documented maximum (10000) on five list tools
root_causes.note: Remainder of the bounds PR #107 restored. The server answers 422, so the cost is one late round trip.

root_causes.title: hours has no documented maximum (168) on list_webhook_deliveries
system_prompt has no documented maxLength (20000) on create and update
root_causes.note: Hosted mode wraps the prompt in 528 extra characters before sending (measured by wide mode), so any hosted prompt over 19472 characters goes out over 20000. A maximum of 20000 on the tool input would not close that gap.

root_causes.title: update_conversation prints Metadata: undefined if the response omits metadata
root_causes.note: The spec allows the omission. A live API that always sends null would never show it.

root_causes.title: language accepts any string
root_causes.note: Already reported upstream as issue #120 with fix PR #121, both open. Not a new finding.
